answer: Each new identity must pass an energy-proof gate. The node derives a per-address nonce from the randomness beacon and demands 36 kWh of verified hashing, proven by signed work receipts. One GPU at 500 W needs 72 hours, about $4.32 at $0.12/kWh. Receipts chain into a public thread anyone can audit, and replaying a nonce fails the beacon cross-check; issuance is capped at one identity per device per epoch. Minting 5,000 clones burns 180 MWh and over $21,600. Like an ocean that records every drop, a counterfeit swimmer still must pour the same water into the echo of the tide.
